descriptor.success_copy: Every planned trial has its observation file. Matched the verification lock: runner, world, configuration. The plan, the trials and the lock agree on the trial count. Every trial that ended on its own stopped for a reason the plan allows. Stop reasons: the default allowed list, which excludes simulation-broken (the plan declares none). Not checked: specs, verifier, lock command speed.
